name: CiviCRM
summary: Manage relationships, contributions, memberships and events in an open-source constituent relationship manager.
cost: Free software; budget separately for hosting, setup and support.
fit: Organizations that want control over their donor and member records.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Someone must maintain the installation, backups and updates. Hosted CiviCRM services have their own prices.

name: CryptPad
summary: Collaborative documents, sheets and other office tools with end-to-end encryption.
cost: Free public-instance accounts and self-hosting are available; additional services are paid.
fit: Teams that want collaborative documents with encryption built into the service.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Storage and support depend on the chosen instance or plan. Understand recovery and sharing before relying on it for essential records.

name: Decidim
summary: Run participation processes, proposals, meetings and collective decisions on an open-source platform.
cost: Free software; deployment and facilitation require resources.
fit: Organizations inviting members or communities into decisions.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Someone must operate the platform and design a fair participation process. A public consultation also needs clear rules and a response to what people say.

name: Donorbox
summary: Donation forms, recurring giving, fundraising pages and donor management.
cost: Platform and payment-processing fees apply; some features and plans add charges.
fit: Organizations that need embedded forms and recurring donations.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: A free-to-start account does not make transactions free. Check the rate for each campaign type, processor, country and add-on.

name: Givebutter
summary: Donation forms, fundraising pages, donor management and events in one hosted service.
cost: Core fundraising is free when optional donor tips are enabled. Paid Plus features are separate.
fit: Teams that want donation pages and supporter records together.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: The pricing page lists a platform fee and standard processing charges when tips are disabled. Confirm eligibility, payment availability and the donor checkout experience.

name: KoboToolbox
summary: Collect and manage survey data for social impact work.
cost: The Community Plan includes 5,000 submissions per month and 1 GB of file storage. Higher capacity is paid.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: The quota is an account limit. Choose the appropriate server and review consent, access controls and the data you actually need.

name: LimeSurvey
summary: Create surveys, collect responses and export results.
cost: Community Edition is free to self-host. Cloud has a limited free plan and paid plans.
fit: Organizations running surveys or community feedback projects.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Cloud response and storage quotas depend on the plan. Self-hosting requires maintenance; good survey design and informed consent still matter.

name: Matomo
summary: Website analytics with self-hosted and managed cloud options.
cost: The on-premise core can be downloaded free; cloud hosting and premium features are paid.
fit: Teams that want to understand website use and choose where analytics are hosted.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Tracking configuration, consent decisions, hosting and updates remain your responsibility. Paid plugins and support can add cost.

name: Metabase
summary: Explore data and build shared dashboards with a query builder and SQL tools.
cost: The open-source edition is free to self-host. Managed plans and additional features are paid.
fit: Organizations with an existing database and someone able to manage access.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Hosting, database connections and permissions need maintenance. A dashboard does not establish that a program caused an outcome.

name: Nextcloud Files
summary: Share and synchronize files through a workspace you can host or obtain from a provider.
cost: Self-hosted software; hosting and enterprise services have separate costs.
fit: Organizations that need shared files with control over their infrastructure.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: You need a maintained installation or a hosting provider. Review sharing permissions, backups and recovery before storing sensitive records.

name: ODK
summary: Build forms with branching, multiple languages and offline data collection.
cost: Open-source software; managed ODK Cloud is a paid service.
fit: Teams collecting data where connectivity is unreliable.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Plan for devices, data collection training and a maintained server or cloud subscription. Cloud capacity and support depend on the plan.

sources.label: Features, open source and Cloud pricing

name: OpenRefine
summary: Clean inconsistent names, categories and formats in a dataset before analyzing it.
fit: Teams cleaning exports, survey results or public data.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: External reconciliation services can receive data you choose to send. Keep a backup and inspect changes before re-importing records.

name: Uwazi
summary: Organize documents and structured records, connect them and publish or search a collection.
cost: Free open-source software and a limited free managed plan; larger managed plans and services are paid.
fit: Teams maintaining an evidence library or documentation project.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Hosting and support depend on the arrangement. Configure permissions and retention around the needs of people represented in the records.

name: WordPress
summary: An open-source publishing system for a charity website, news and public resources.
cost: Free software; hosting, domains and some plugins or themes are separate.
fit: Teams maintaining a public website and regularly publishing material.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Choose maintained plugins, keep software updated and assign responsibility for backups and accessibility. WordPress.org is the software project.

name: Zeffy
summary: Hosted fundraising tools with a model funded by optional donor contributions to Zeffy.
cost: The provider says it covers platform and transaction fees through optional donor contributions.
fit: Eligible nonprofits looking for fundraising without fees charged to the organization.
eligibility: No nonprofit discount is assumed. Check the provider’s current terms and availability.
limits: Eligibility and payment availability still apply. Review how the optional contribution appears to donors before choosing a service.
